_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Overture to Despair#000.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の外で Sui と合流する。

Overture to Despair#001.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#001.dst: …{p}。はは、芸術品だって観光客が言ってたの、嘘じゃなかったんだ。
Overture to Despair#001.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#002.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#002.dst: ここに住むのはいいだろうね… よそで起きてること、全部無視できて…
Overture to Despair#002.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#003.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#003.dst: {u}、あの… あの「筆頭」の君主を見つけなきゃ！そうすれば… はは、Rex と Zeph を救える。
Overture to Despair#003.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#004.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#004.dst: なんでだめなの？！何も考えずに Deraj へ突っ込んで、みんなを解放しようとしたのはあなたでしょ！
Overture to Despair#004.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#005.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#005.dst: じゃあなんで私はだめなの？！待てば待つほど、な、何か起きちゃう！！もう行かなきゃ！
Overture to Despair#005.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#006.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#006.dst: あるよ。君主を見つける。Rex と Zeph を解放する。そして逃げる！
Overture to Despair#006.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#007.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#007.dst: 細かいことは… い、行きながら考える。ほんとに！とにかくもう行こう！
Overture to Despair#007.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#010.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#010.dst: たぶん… 樹冠？樹冠に連れていけばいい！それなら… なんとか…
Overture to Despair#010.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#011.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#011.dst: えっと… し、知らない。でも、知ってる人を見つけて、む、無理やり聞き出せばいい！
Overture to Despair#011.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#012.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#012.dst: できるよ。Fuhue 隊長が… やり方をいくつか教えてくれたの！あとは… 知ってる人を… 見つけるだけ…
Overture to Despair#012.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#013.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#013.dst: ひ、必要なら！！Gikyo だって、こ、殺せたじゃない？
Overture to Despair#013.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#014.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#014.dst: 大変だったけど… それに Majin は… たぶんもっと強い…
Overture to Despair#014.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#015.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#015.dst: よし。いい！まず私たちは…
Overture to Despair#015.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#018.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#018.dst: わかった、そうかもね！でも… もう！！何かしなきゃ！
Overture to Despair#018.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#019.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#019.dst: …そうだね。それは… 賢い。{p} から、えっと、噂が広まってるよね…？もっと目立たないようにしないと。
Overture to Despair#019.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#020.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
Overture to Despair#020.dst: それに… 必要な情報が見つかるまで、どれくらいかかるか分からない。だから… 泊まる場所も？
Overture to Despair#020.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#021.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#021.dst: よし。服を探して、泊まる場所を探す。それが計画。できるよ。
Overture to Despair#021.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#025.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#025.dst: ええ。{p} で育ちました。
Overture to Despair#025.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#026.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#026.dst: とはいえ実は… ほとんど出たことがないのです。地方巡りを終えたら軍に入るつもりでして。
Overture to Despair#026.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#027.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#027.dst: 地方を巡る往復券のため、何年も貯金してきました… 恵まれない地域をこの目で見たいのです。
Overture to Despair#027.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#028.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#028.dst: 祭りが終わったらすぐ発ちます。楽しみでしょう？
Overture to Despair#028.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#029.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#029.dst: ホテル… ふむ。いくつか知っていますが、ほとんどは祭りを控えて満室でしょう。
Overture to Despair#029.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#030.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#030.dst: 銀行の北に高級ホテルがあります… 王冠の宝石、だったかな？ただ、あなた方には高すぎるでしょうね。
Overture to Despair#030.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#031.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#031.dst: 良い質問だ。正直よく分かりません… ここで育つと見過ごすものも多くて。
Overture to Despair#031.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#032.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#032.dst: ただ、観光客はたいてい屋敷や城を見に来ますね。ご興味は？
Overture to Despair#032.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#035.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#035.dst: この良き日に、何かご用ですか？
Overture to Despair#035.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#036.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#036.dst: この上なく元気です！お気遣いありがとう。
Overture to Despair#036.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#037.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#037.dst: ありがたくも仕事の合間に一時間いただいたので… バラの香りを楽しむことに。この街の美しさを味わうために。
Overture to Despair#037.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#038.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#038.dst: ああ… 下層区からの観光客ですかな？旅行の割り当ての良い使い道です。
Overture to Despair#038.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#039.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#039.dst: 西側の賑やかな市場はぜひ。見逃したらもったいない！
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#040.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#040.dst: 街の外へ出たいなら、山を見に連れていってくれるガイドもいるそうですよ！
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#041.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#041.dst: ええ、{p} は高級ファッションで有名でしょう？ご存じのはずです… どちらのご出身であれ。
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#042.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#042.dst: ご興味があれば、名門 Til 家が北に期間限定の服屋を出していますよ。
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#043.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#043.dst: 良い滞在を！女王陛下に栄光あれ！
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#045.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#045.dst: 泊まる所を考えておくべきだった… 汽車は初めてで、そっちがうまくいくことばかり考えてたんだ！
Overture to Despair#045.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#046.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#046.dst: 今じゃ王冠の宝石以外のホテルは全部満室！ま… まさか野宿することに？
Overture to Despair#046.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#047.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#047.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#048.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#048.dst: ああ、ありがとう、ありがとう！きっと女王陛下が遣わしてくれたんだ！
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#049.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#049.dst: …あなたもエメラルドが足りないの？じゃあ一緒に心地いい茂みで寝ようか！はは…
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#050.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#050.dst: ああ、一生忘れない！あなたのおかげで最高の祭りになったよ！
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#051.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#051.dst: 早く故郷の年寄りたちに話したい！女王陛下がこの奇跡を授けてくださったって…
Overture to Despair#051.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#052.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#052.dst: でも、女王じゃなくて… ああ、もういい。
Overture to Despair#052.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#053.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#053.dst: いらっしゃい、いらっしゃい！上等な新聞はいかが？今日は雑誌がお好みかな― おいしいゴシップがありますよ。
Overture to Despair#053.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#054.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#054.dst: うーん… Crown of Seraphim コレクションか、Peacock Couture か…
Overture to Despair#054.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#055.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#055.dst: ああ、これは大事… 一年分の給料をつぎ込むんだから！
Overture to Despair#055.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#058.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#058.dst: それならついてますね！なにせ期間限定の服屋ですから。
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#059.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#059.dst: 本日は Til 家の代理で来ています。春の新作はほぼ完売なので、ご興味があるなら今のうちに！
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#060.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#060.dst: えっと… これがこの辺の流行？
Overture to Despair#060.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#061.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#061.dst: ええ。地方中から人がこういう限定イベントに買い物に来るんです。
Overture to Despair#061.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#062.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#062.dst: Til 家は、最も豪華な衣装に孔雀の羽の模様を取り入れることで有名なんですよ！
Overture to Despair#062.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#063.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#063.dst: 色も豊富です― すべてこの地区の地元産の染料です！
Overture to Despair#063.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#064.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#064.dst: 派手なのはいらない。とにかく… 一番安いのを見せて、いい？
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#065.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#065.dst: なんと！お嬢さん、ファッションは安くないんですよ！ぜひ私のおすすめを―
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#066.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#066.dst: いらない。一番安いのを買わせて。
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#067.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#067.dst: まあ… そこまでおっしゃるなら…
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#068.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#068.dst: どうぞ、うちで一番安いものです。合計で… {~} EB になります。
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#069.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#069.dst: 結構。どうぞ。では、お引き取りを。その態度は商売の邪魔です！
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#070.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#070.dst: よし… 服はこれで。あとは… 泊まる場所。えっと、ホテルとか…
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#071.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#071.dst: ほらね！流行は安くないんです！
Overture to Despair#071.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#072.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#072.dst: ああ、戻られましたか。申した通り、服は {~} EB です。
Overture to Despair#072.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#073.dst: [?] (この会話は現在機能していません)
Overture to Despair#073.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#074.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#074.dst: ああ… いいですか、在庫を全部売らないとボーナスが出ないんです！
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#075.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#075.dst: ですから、もっと服を買う気がないなら… お引き取りください。
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#077.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#077.dst: まあ、ようこそ王冠の宝石へ！ご用件をお伺いします。
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#079.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#079.dst: ご予約はございますか？
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#080.dst: えっと… な、ない。でも―
Overture to Despair#080.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#081.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check out listings...
Overture to Despair#081.dst: なるほど。では空室を急ぎ確認いたしますね…
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#082.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#082.dst: あら！運がよろしいですね！ダブルルームが一室空いております！ただ長くはもちませんよ― 飛ぶように売れておりますので！
Overture to Despair#082.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#083.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#083.dst: もっと… 広いお部屋？本当に？こちらからはお二人しか見えませんし―
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#084.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#084.dst: あとで… 友達が来るの。まだ、えっと、着いてないだけ。
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#085.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#085.dst: なるほど。なるほど、それは確かに厄介ですね…
Overture to Despair#085.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#086.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#086.dst: お連れ様？どのような方で？ご歓談だけでしたら、ダブルで十分かと―
Overture to Despair#086.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#087.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#087.dst: ううん、一緒に… 泊まるの。
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#088.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#088.dst: ふむ。ええ、それは確かに困りますね。ふむ…
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#089.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#089.dst: そうですね。豪華スイートも空いてはおります。ただ、かなりのお値段で…
Overture to Despair#089.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#090.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.
Overture to Despair#090.dst: そ、それでいい。私が払う。
Overture to Despair#090.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#091.src: You're certain? Apologies if I am making assumptions here, but you do not seem the sort who would have-
Overture to Despair#091.dst: 本当に？憶測でしたら失礼ですが、そのようなお金をお持ちの方には―
Overture to Despair#091.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#093.src: ...huh. Well, everything seems in order then. Here are your keys, madame.
Overture to Despair#093.dst: …まあ。では問題ございませんね。こちらが鍵です、お客様。
Overture to Despair#093.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#095.src: {u}, I'm... going up to the room.
Overture to Despair#095.dst: {u}、私… 先に部屋へ行ってる。
Overture to Despair#095.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#096.src: No. We're... not here for pleasure, {u}. We're here to... to... to save our friends.
Overture to Despair#096.dst: ううん。遊びに来たんじゃないよ、{u}。私たちは… 友達を… 救いに来たの。
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#097.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.
Overture to Despair#097.dst: 私、えっと… お腹空いてない。それに、はは、お酒って気分でもない。
Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#098.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#098.dst: …でも、あなたは、えっと、見て回ってもいいよ。も、もしよければ。ただ… 遅くならないで。
Overture to Despair#098.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#099.src: We're in... room {~}, apparently. I'll... leave the door open for you.
Overture to Despair#099.dst: 部屋は… {~} 号室みたい。ドアは… 開けておくね。
Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#100.src: Head to your room and discuss what to do next.
Overture to Despair#100.dst: 部屋へ行き、次にすべきことを話し合う。

Overture to Despair#101.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#101.dst: あら！本日はどうなさいました？
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#102.src: The {p} are known for thier very scenic walks and hikes! I would recommend walking around the lakes or hiking up to the mountains.
Overture to Despair#102.dst: {p} は景色の良い散歩道やハイキングで有名です！湖の周りの散歩や、山へのハイキングがおすすめですよ。
Overture to Despair#102.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#103.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#103.dst: {p} は豊かな酒文化でも知られております。様々なお酒を造っており、地元の酒場で楽しめます。
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#104.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#104.dst: 祭りが近いため、現在は特にイベントを開催しておりません。
Overture to Despair#104.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#105.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#105.dst: 普段はバーでゲームナイトやクイズを開いております！
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#106.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#106.dst: まあ、ご満足いただけませんか？
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#107.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#107.dst: どのような問題がございました？
Overture to Despair#107.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#108.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#108.dst: 申し訳ございません！後ほど清掃係にふかふかにさせますね！
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#109.dst: ご意見ありがとうございます。
Overture to Despair#109.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#110.src: Oh I will let our cleaners know to do a better job.
Overture to Despair#110.dst: まあ、清掃係にもっと丁寧にやるよう伝えます。
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#111.dst: ご意見ありがとうございます。
Overture to Despair#111.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#112.src: Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to help with that.
Overture to Despair#112.dst: あいにく、そちらはどうにもいたしかねます。
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#113.dst: ご意見ありがとうございます。
Overture to Despair#113.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#114.src: Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better!
Overture to Despair#114.dst: ご滞在をより快適にできることがあれば、お申し付けください！
Overture to Despair#114.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#115.dst: * - 午後 {~} 時以降は静粛に。
Overture to Despair#115.speaker: Rules of The Crown Jewel

Overture to Despair#116.src: A year of saving... f-finally payed off!
Overture to Despair#116.dst: 一年の貯金が… つ、ついに報われた！
Overture to Despair#116.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#117.src: A... a giant meal, and a nice hotel... and I have it all to m-myself!! Best! Week!! Ever!!
Overture to Despair#117.dst: ご… ご馳走に、いいホテル… しかも全部ひ、独り占め！！最高の！一週間！！だ！！
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#120.dst: ウイスキー *げふっ* もっと！！！！
Overture to Despair#120.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#121.src: ...I had heard that about the Auburn Festival!
Overture to Despair#121.dst: …Auburn の祭りの話は聞いていましたよ！
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#122.src: I can't say I expected word to reach {p} from over there. Though, let me say... so far, I am very impressed by how {p} handles festivities.
Overture to Despair#122.dst: あちらの噂が {p} まで届くとは。でも正直… {p} のお祭りの盛り上がりには感心しています。
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#123.src: Why, the real festivities haven't even begun! You're in for a treat, my friend.
Overture to Despair#123.dst: いやいや、本番はまだこれからですよ！楽しみにしていてください。
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#124.src: ...by chance, would you let me show you around when the festival starts in full? I've enjoyed our talks so far.
Overture to Despair#124.dst: …もしよければ、祭りが本格的に始まったら案内させてもらえませんか？お話がとても楽しくて。
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#125.src: I'd love that. I've never been outside the {p} before... so it would be nice to have someone to guide me, wouldn't it?
Overture to Despair#125.dst: ぜひ。{p} から出たことがなくて… 案内してくれる人がいたら心強いですよね？
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#126.dst: やった！では約束ですね！
Overture to Despair#126.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#127.src: Ah, I'm so glad we meet again!
Overture to Despair#127.dst: ああ、また会えて嬉しい！
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#128.src: Even though you... barged into my room... er, isn't that against hotel policy?
Overture to Despair#128.dst: でも… 私の部屋に押しかけて… ええと、それってホテルの規則違反じゃない？
Overture to Despair#128.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#129.src: ...oh, well, I won't tell them. You did help me pay for the room, after all! I wish you all the best.
Overture to Despair#129.dst: …まあいいや、黙っておくよ。部屋代を手伝ってくれたしね！元気でね。
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#130.src: Maybe we'll meet again! Perhaps I could buy you a drink at the festival?
Overture to Despair#130.dst: また会えるかも！お祭りで一杯おごらせてくれる？
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#131.src: ...oh, you're here. Are you done looking around?
Overture to Despair#131.dst: …あ、来たんだ。見て回るのは終わった？
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#132.src: So, um. I've been... planning our next steps. Finding a place to stay was... a good idea, I guess. You were right. I shouldn't... rush into it.
Overture to Despair#132.dst: それで、えっと。次にどうするか… 考えてたの。泊まる所を探したのは… よかったと思う。あなたが正しかった。焦っちゃ… だめだよね。
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: But this is a good place to regroup once we... once we get Rex and Zeph back. We should, ha, act as early as possible, though.
Overture to Despair#133.dst: でもここは、Rex と Zeph を… 取り戻したあとに集まるにはいい場所。ただ、はは、できるだけ早く動かないと。
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#134.src: Stop that. You k-keep doing that, acting as if... a-as if the worst is inevitable! It's not helpful!
Overture to Despair#134.dst: やめて。い、いつもそう、まるで… さ、最悪の結果が避けられないみたいに！そんなの何の役にも立たない！
Overture to Despair#134.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#135.src: Well... don't!! I know already, I know they might be gone, but I- I can't think like that. I can't. I have to believe they're still... fighting!!
Overture to Despair#135.dst: なら… やめてよ！！分かってる、もういないかもって。でも私… そんなふうに考えられない。無理。まだ… 戦ってるって信じなきゃ！！
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#136.src: ...um. Anyway, we should... l-look around the town. To try and figure out where they're being held. If we can figure that out, then...
Overture to Despair#136.dst: …えっと。とにかく… ま、街を見て回ろう。二人がどこに捕まってるか探るの。それが分かれば…
Overture to Despair#136.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#137.src: Look around the town, I guess... try and figure out where that Sovereign is keeping them. If we can figure that out, then... we can save them.
Overture to Despair#137.dst: 街を見て回ろう… あの君主が二人をどこに閉じ込めてるか探るの。それが分かれば… 助けられる。
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#138.src: We should start right away. Come on.
Overture to Despair#138.dst: すぐに始めよう。行こう。
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#139.src: I can't, I can't, I can't. If I stop for... for even a second, I'll... I'll shatter. I have to keep moving. I have to.
Overture to Despair#139.dst: 無理、無理、無理。一秒でも… 立ち止まったら、私… 砕けちゃう。動き続けなきゃ。そうしなきゃ。
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#140.src: What do you think?! NO, I'm not doing alright!! But I have to do something about it, or... or... I'll shatter.
Overture to Despair#140.dst: どう思う？！大丈夫なわけない！！でも何かしないと… 私… 砕けちゃう。
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#141.src: You can... stay here and rest if you, um, need to. But I'm going to search the city for clues. By myself if... if I have to.
Overture to Despair#141.dst: あなたは… ここで休んでてもいいよ、えっと、必要なら。でも私は街で手がかりを探す。ひ… 一人でも。
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#143.src: Meet up with Sui outside the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#143.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の王冠の宝石の外で Sui と合流する。

Overture to Despair#145.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#145.dst: この… この風鈴。見て。
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#146.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#146.dst: …え？違う、壁を見てるの。何を見てると思ったの？
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#147.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#147.dst: この風鈴。これは… {p} での抵抗の象徴なの。S… えっと、Syndra が教えてくれた。
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#148.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: 風は… 自由と、自由意志を表してる。でも、風鈴がこんな所まで伝わってるなんて…？
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#149.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#149.dst: これって… 私が思ってる通りの意味？
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#150.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: やっぱり… やっぱりそうだ！抵抗の象徴、つ、つまり {p} にもレジスタンスがあるはず！！
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#151.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#151.dst: 私たち… 彼らを探さなきゃ、{u}！
Overture to Despair#151.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#152.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#152.dst: …あ。そうだね。えっと、ごめん。ちょっと… 興奮しちゃった。
Overture to Despair#152.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#153.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#153.dst: …あ。しまった。えっと、大声じゃなかったといいけど…
Overture to Despair#153.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#154.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: と、とにかく。風鈴に… 何か文字が刻まれてる。
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#155.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#155.dst: 「変革の風は西より吹き、真実の波を我らの岸へ打ち寄せる」
Overture to Despair#155.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#156.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#156.dst: …そこがレジスタンスの居場所だ！さ、探しに行こう！
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#157.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#157.dst: {p} で風鈴に示された場所を探す：変革の風は西より吹き、真実の波を我らの岸へ打ち寄せる。

Overture to Despair#158.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#158.dst: …あれ。ここには… レジスタンスはいないみたい。また風鈴があるだけ。
Overture to Despair#158.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#159.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#159.dst: これにも何か書いてある？
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#160.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#160.dst: 次の場所を探す：富と強欲の館の頂に深く根を張り、枝は風のささやきを聞く。

Overture to Despair#161.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#161.dst: 次の場所を探す：ささやきは団結を語り、埋もれた鋼の線で地域が交わる場所に呼び起こされる。

Overture to Despair#162.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#162.dst: 次の場所を探す：日ごと声は探求者を迎える。真実を見極め、刷られた秘密を読め。

Overture to Despair#163.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#163.dst: いらっしゃい、いらっしゃい！上等な新聞はいかが？今日は雑誌がお好みかな― おいしいゴシップがありますよ。
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#164.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#165.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: …えっと。私たち、あなたの… えっと、風鈴にすごく興味があって。
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#166.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#166.dst: 風鈴？はい？何のことだかさっぱり。{p} の方にあるとは聞きますが、ここで？妙なことをおっしゃる。
Overture to Despair#166.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#167.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#167.dst: それはさておき、新聞はいかが？ちなみに… お二人はどちらから？この辺りでは見かけない顔ですね！
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#168.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#168.dst: ははは、おやおや。どうやって来たかじゃなく、どこから来たかを聞いたんです。もう一度！どちらのご出身で？
Overture to Despair#168.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#169.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#169.dst: ええ、私も今日郵便受けで金の延べ棒を見つけましたよ！ははは、その手には乗りません― {p} にはもう何百年も誰も住んでいない！さあ、真面目に！本気で聞いてるんです。
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#170.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?
Overture to Despair#170.dst: 誰だってそうです― ミルクと愛から生まれた、とか言いますね。でも宇宙の起源の話をしたら夜が明けちゃう。で、本当はどこから？
Overture to Despair#170.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#171.src: Ahaaa, I see! So you're looking for the people who seek the truth. A noble endeavour, certainly.
Overture to Despair#171.dst: あはぁ、なるほど！真実を求める人々をお探しなんですね。立派な志です。
Overture to Despair#171.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#172.src: We'd, um, love to meet some more of these... truth... seekers...?
Overture to Despair#172.dst: 私たち、えっと、その… 真実を… 求める人に… もっと会いたいな…？
Overture to Despair#172.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#173.src: There's many a like-minded individual if you know where to look. So allow me to catch your eye with the Aelumia Times! It's the best way to keep up with current events.
Overture to Despair#173.dst: 探す場所さえ分かれば、同志は大勢いますよ。というわけで、『Aelumia 新聞』をおすすめします！時事を追うには一番です。
Overture to Despair#173.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#174.src: Column {~} will often print the phrase of the day. Read up, and pay close attention! Things will kick off here at midnight.
Overture to Despair#174.dst: 第 {~} 欄にはよく「今日の合言葉」が載ります。よく読んで、注意深く！ここでは深夜零時に始まります。
Overture to Despair#174.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#175.src: I wish you two good luck on your endeavours. May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#175.dst: お二人の志に幸運を。久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん。
Overture to Despair#175.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#176.src: Th-thank you. Um... may we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change!
Overture to Despair#176.dst: あ、ありがとう。…久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん！
Overture to Despair#176.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#177.src: Leave the shop and discuss the next steps.
Overture to Despair#177.dst: 店を出て次の手を話し合う。

Overture to Despair#178.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.
Overture to Despair#178.dst: 久しく埋もれし真実を掘り起こし、変革をもたらさん。決して忘れずに。
Overture to Despair#178.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#179.src: Finally! Finally, finally, something good is happening!
Overture to Despair#179.dst: やっと！やっと、やっと、いいことが起きた！
Overture to Despair#179.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#180.src: I didn't even think there'd be a resistance in {p}... it just seems so... idyllic, here. Like... um, like they don't really have... issues.
Overture to Despair#180.dst: {p} にレジスタンスがあるなんて思わなかった… ここはすごく… のどかに見えるし。まるで… えっと、何の問題もないみたいに。
Overture to Despair#180.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#181.src: But... I guess we don't know what life is like here... um, either way, if they're a resistance, they have to have intel.
Overture to Despair#181.dst: でも… ここの暮らしは分からないよね… えっと、どっちにしろ、レジスタンスなら情報を持ってるはず。
Overture to Despair#181.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#182.src: Here, hand me that newspaper. Okay... Column {~}... looks like today's phrase of the day is... "No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot?"
Overture to Despair#182.dst: ほら、その新聞貸して。えっと… 第 {~} 欄… 今日の合言葉は…「緑の Squirmle Pot なんて存在しない？」
Overture to Despair#182.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#183.src: Weird. But... I guess nobody's going to guess it!
Overture to Despair#183.dst: 変なの。でも… これなら誰にも当てられないね！
Overture to Despair#183.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#184.src: Okay. Okay... th-this is happening! Majin Thalas, "number one" Sovereign, we're coming for you...
Overture to Despair#184.dst: よし。よし… つ、ついに始まる！Majin Thalas、「筆頭」の君主、今行くからね…
Overture to Despair#184.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#185.src: I'm feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#185.dst: だいぶ気分が良くなった。えっと… じゃあ今は何しよう？深夜零時を… 待つあいだ。
Overture to Despair#185.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#186.src: Yes... um, thinking about it now, I guess I am kind of starving...
Overture to Despair#186.dst: うん… えっと、考えてみたら、お腹ぺこぺこかも…
Overture to Despair#186.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#187.src: I remember seeing a restaurant earlier! Follow me.
Overture to Despair#187.dst: さっきレストランを見かけたの！ついてきて。
Overture to Despair#187.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#188.src: I... I guess I could use a nap...
Overture to Despair#188.dst: 私… ちょっと昼寝したいかも…

Overture to Despair#194.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#195.src: Um... I'll take the tacos, please.
Overture to Despair#195.dst: えっと… タコスをお願い。
Overture to Despair#195.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#196.src: Coming right up! It'll just be a few minutes.
Overture to Despair#196.dst: かしこまりました！数分でお持ちします。
Overture to Despair#196.speaker: Waiter

Overture to Despair#197.src: ...it's nice here, isn't it? I hadn't... really let myself notice that before. I can see why people talk about the {p} so much...
Overture to Despair#197.dst: …ここ、いいところだね。今まで… 気づかないようにしてた。みんなが {p} の話ばかりする理由が分かる…
Overture to Despair#197.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#198.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even, even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#198.dst: 私… もう。まだすごく腹が立つ。何もかもに！王家にも、君主にも… {p} の人たちにも！！世界が終わったみたいなのに、ふ、普通に暮らしてるから。
Overture to Despair#198.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#199.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance we'll get to see them again.

Overture to Despair#200.src: And... is it weird that I kind of miss the Canopy, too? Even though they were... annoying, and overbearing, and- and kind of... scary?

Overture to Despair#201.src: ...and Yusanu. I hope he's alright. I- I, ha, I really hope he can free his family too. I... I, um, don't want him to lose anyone either.

Overture to Despair#201.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#202.src: ...I hope he doesn't hate me. After what I said to him.

Overture to Despair#202.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#204.src: Um... while we wait. Is there anything you want to talk about?

Overture to Despair#204.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#205.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#206.src: Like... like I could take as much as I want and it wouldn't change a thing. And, ha, it scares me, a little. It's so... different, to how it was before, but...

Overture to Despair#206.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#209.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#211.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#212.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#214.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#215.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#216.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#217.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Resistance Member
